items.title: v2.1.304
items.summary: What's changed Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked Added e.isReadOnly to a mod's tool.check event, set when the tool call is read-only Added /auto-mode-setup : a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway

items.title: v2.1.303
items.summary: What's changed Bug fixes and reliability improvements

items.title: v2.1.302
items.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode Added an Idle compaction row to /config for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off Added a notice to /design-sync and /design-login that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026 Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs

items.title: v2.1.301
items.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS so unattended retry mode ( CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG ) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the claude-api skill, including setting up trace destinations with the ant CLI Added the % motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y Added rows to a mod's Input : a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line Added classifier_verdict and permiss

items.title: v2.1.300
items.summary: What's changed Added virtualText to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt Added cache_creation_5m_tokens and cache_creation_1h_tokens to the OpenTelemetry api_request event, splitting cache writes by lifetime Added $.ui.view({ agentId }) for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and $.ui.view({}) goes back Added a dir prop on a mod's Text for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right Added /advisor on Claude Platform on AWS; no adv

items.title: v2.1.299
items.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS environment variable: Claude gets the paths of @ file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all Added CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; "idleCompaction": false in settings.json turns it off.
